title: DOW-UAP-D089, Range Fouler Debrief, Eastern United States, 2020
doc_notes: This document is a blank Range Fouler Debrief form template with a brief narrative description of a UAP sighting included as an example or record, released by the Department of the Navy.

incidents.summary: A U.S. military pilot observed a small, metallic object with a reflective underside moving in a constant direction.
incidents.quote: Appeared quite small. Speed appeared to be and continued in constant direction. Shape indiscernible but the bottom was reflective.
